verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client, not itself a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, endpoint, or serve mode. The Cursor, VS Code Copilot and Codex AGENTS.md integrations, and the general "works with your agents" claim, are adjacent integration patterns rather than an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
